labeling.evidence: quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

In this study, differences in global protein expression of small intestinal biopsy specimens from CD patients were quantified by analyzing formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded material using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry and label-free protein quantitation.
keywords: Human; Small intestine; Ffpe; Celiac disease; Label-free quantification; Shot-gun proteomics
